name: Nyírbogdány (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Nyírbogdány (a red and green shield with a figure and a sheaf of grain, above a scroll) above the name NYÍRBOGDÁNY in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
